08 / 11.04.2025

This application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the opposite party no. 2 vide A.B.A. No. 1962 of 2023 in connection with Palamau (Daltonganj) Mahila Town P.S. Case No. 44 of 2022 mainly registered under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 / 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. It was submitted that after settling the dispute, the opposite party no. 2 has violated the terms and conditions, as decided in the mediation proceeding between the parties.

3. From perusal of the impugned order dated 07.07.2023 passed in A.B.A. No. 1962 of 2023, it appears that no condition was imposed on the petitioner / opposite party no. 2 herein, for grant of anticipatory bail.
No ground for cancellation of anticipatory bail of the opposite party no. 2 is made out.
